title: Yacht caps and summers in Atlantic City
summary: Crawford explains why he wore captain's caps at Atlantic City, where Basie and Lennie Hayton did too.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Well, I think to close out, I would like to ask you about the yacht caps and Atlantic City.

Well, I don't know, I had me an urge to wear a captain's cap, whether it was white or whether it was Navy blue, or dark. I just loved to wear them while in Atlantic City, because we went there for every summer for quite a number of years, my wife and I. And all of a sudden, I looked up, Count Basie had one on. Lena Horne's husband, Lennie Hayton had and he hated to have one on all the time. Well, they must have saw me with it and they liked it and thought it appropriate.
So that's all I got to say about that. So I wore my hat all the time.
